author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Fifteen years ago, the Marvel Cinematic Universe kicked into high gear with the release of the first Thor and Captain America films. In the collection archive of Cinema Relics, Adam checks out the hero costumes from those movies, which established a unique visual identity to the MCU that bridged the comics and the real world. Plus, Adam takes a close look at every version of Thor's hammer to appear on screen, examining the surprising differences between every Mjolnir hero prop!

Learn more about Cinema Relics prop investigations at: https://www.youtube.com/@cinemarelics/videos
